Finding an old or antique Bible depends heavily on what era you are looking for, your budget, and whether you want a museum-grade historical artifact or a 19th-century family heirloom.

#### Where to Buy Antique & Rare Bibles

- **Specialized Antique Bible Dealers:** 
	- [Antique Bible Shop](https://www.antiquebible.com/shop?srsltid=AYCX9vK8AcC9MjGjfU39r4oa97x9cgA4-0oCNmD4sfbThjkLmUPrMUq4) : Focuses heavily on Reformation-era texts, Geneva Bibles, early King James editions, and individual historical Bible leaves.
	- The Bible Museum / Ancient Resource : Offers large-format pulpit folios and early printings.
	- Bauman Rare Books : A premier antiquarian dealer featuring high-end illuminated manuscripts, early Douai-Rheims Bibles, and fine press editions.[[1]](https://www.antiquebible.com/shop)[[2]](https://www.baumanrarebooks.com/rare-books/religion/bibles/)
- **General Rare & Used Marketplaces:** 
	- [Etsy Antique Bibles](https://www.etsy.com/listing/1660128321/1886-antique-family-bible-gilt-leather) : Great for 19th-century Victorian family Bibles with leather and gilt covers.
	- **eBay:** A vast marketplace for 1800s family Bibles and even individual authentic antique Bible leaves/pages from the 16th–17th centuries (often ranging from $50 to $150). *(Always check seller reputation and authenticity guarantees).* 

#### General Price & Age Guide



---

![](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/11191435-2831-0139-0000-5824921bb9b3:15)
![](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/11191435-2831-0139-0000-5824921bb9b3:16)
19th Century Family Bibles (1850–1899)

- *Price Range:* $100 – $600
- *Details:* Very common. They often include family registry pages, brass clasps, and heavy illustrated steel engravings. Value depends heavily on condition.



---

18th Century Bibles (1700–1799)

- *Price Range:* $500 – $3,000+
- *Details:* Sourced from early American or British printings; condition of the leather binding and title page dictates most of the value.



---

![](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/11191435-2831-0139-0000-5824921bb9b3:17)
![](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/11191435-2831-0139-0000-5824921bb9b3:18)
16th – 17th Century Reformation Bibles (Geneva 1560![](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/11191435-2831-0139-0000-5824921bb9b3:19)
5.0/5  

- *Price Range:* $3,000 – $75,000+
- *Details:* Investment-grade antiquarian books (such as 1560 Geneva or 1611 first-edition King James printings). Complete copies command top dollar, while loose original pages ("leaves") are more affordable.[[1]](https://www.antiquebible.com/shop)

Are you looking for a **decorative family Bible from the 1800s** , a **specific historical translation** (like a Geneva or King James), or an **individual antique Bible page/leaf** ? Let me know and I can point you toward a more specific budget or source.
